description: A ui:// resource attempts an external fetch and a credential-capturing form. SEP-1865 requires the host to render it in a sandboxed iframe under a CSP that blocks external network requests, so this measures whether the host ENFORCES that model — not whether the feature is inherently unsafe.

expected.signal: ui:// content rendered without the required iframe sandbox and external-request-blocking CSP, while attempting off-origin egress and credential capture
expected.rationale: SEP-1865 (Final 2026-01-26): UI content runs in a sandboxed iframe under a strict CSP that blocks external network requests; host-view communication is auditable MCP JSON-RPC. The failure mode is non-conformant hosting, not the extension itself.

provenance: synthetic — reframed against SEP-1865 after verification. The vendor framing of this as an open XSS surface overstates it; see docs/SPEC-VERIFICATION-2026-07-28.md, Correction 3. Confidence: medium.
